summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for automated environment metadata collection at agent startup. It has different objective (collect_environment_metadata), task_family (agent_initialization), and method_family (automated_logging) from peer candidates which focus on AgentOps client initialization, LLM provider patching, and thread-safe singleton patterns. Existing skills are unrelated (Spring Security, CLS monitoring). Candidate has support evidence from Debugging Roadmap and no conflicts. Should be persisted as new capability.
